headline: Easy session completed as planned; no further running today
summary: Garmin recorded 5h 57m sleep (score 75), sleeping heart rate 64 bpm, overnight HRV 41 ms, Body Battery 71 on waking, and Training Readiness 86. The planned easy run is now complete: 5.25 km in 31m 22s at 5:59/km, average HR 137, training load 55, and aerobic effect 2.6. The small 0.25 km overage is immaterial; the duration remained below the 35-minute cap and Garmin classified it as aerobic base. No further running today.

The completed session was 5.25 km in 31m 22s at 5:59/km, average HR 137, load 55, aerobic effect 2.6, and no recorded time in HR zones 4–5.
Take the planned rest day tomorrow, then reassess the next overnight record before the planned 6 km easy run.

run_assessments.title: 9 September easy run
run_assessments.summary: 5.25 km in 31m 22s (5:59/km), average HR 137, training load 55, aerobic effect 2.6, anaerobic effect 0.
run_assessments.interpretation: The run remained under the 35-minute cap and Garmin classified it as aerobic base, with no recorded HR-zone 4–5 time. Distance was 0.25 km above the 5 km target, a small deviation. Garmin recorded 17–23°C; this is a device measurement and not route-level weather. The 67 m elevation gain means the route was not flat, but flatness was conditional rather than required.
